نستجدي (form X)
# نَسْتَجْدِي (nastajdī) /nas.tad͡ʒ.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
# نَسْتَجْدِيَ (nastajdiya) /nas.tad͡ʒ.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
